candidates.fact: LME copper flash squeeze with constrained available inventory, extreme backwardation and physical deliveries responding to tightness.
China mainstream-region copper inventories fell 19,700 mt WoW to 114,200 mt; supply marginally tight while end-user purchasing remained insufficient.
Expected US refined-copper tariffs diverted metal toward the US, lifting COMEX inventory and tightening availability outside the US.
China major-region copper inventories fell 24,900 mt WoW to 109,500 mt; regional demand diverged and supply was marginally tight.
Codelco first-half copper output fell 11% with operational restrictions at El Teniente, lower Chuquicamata output and lower grades at Ministro Hales.
